grounding_quotes: Before extraction, the server must validate the archive. It must reject malformed ZIP files, archives with more than 100 members, archives whose expanded content exceeds 20 MiB, absolute paths, parent directory traversal paths, duplicate member paths, symlinks, unsupported member types, and any file whose extension is not one of the allowed extensions: ".txt", ".csv", ".json", or ".md".
Executable, script, dangerous, or otherwise non-allowlisted file types must not be extracted.
All destination paths must resolve beneath the application-owned extraction directory.
If validation fails or an extraction constraint is violated, the server must not publish partially extracted output.

Archives are rejected if they are malformed, contain more than 100 members, expand beyond 20 MiB, contain absolute paths, parent traversal, duplicate paths, symlinks, unsupported member types, or files without one of the allowed extensions: .txt, .csv, .json, .md.
